Privileged Data Access Abuse [Information Disclosure, Elevation of Privilege, CWE-732] on RDS, Redshift, DynamoDB, EMR: Privileged users with access to analytics systems might attempt to extract sensitive user financial data through direct database queries, EMR jobs, or by exploiting overly permissive IAM roles. DDoS and Resource Exhaustion [Denial of Service, CWE-400] on CloudFront, API Gateway, ALB, Lambda, ECS: Attackers might attempt to overwhelm system resources by generating a high volume of requests or exploiting resource-intensive operations in the application. An attacker uses a botnet to generate thousands of transaction requests per second, attempting to exhaust API Gateway limits or overwhelm the transaction processing services.

HTTP Request Smuggling [Tampering, Information Disclosure, CWE-444] on CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway: Attackers exploit differences in how front-end and back-end servers interpret HTTP requests, potentially leading to request smuggling or cache poisoning. An attacker crafts specially formatted HTTP requests that exploit timing differences between CloudFront and ALB, allowing them to poison the cache or steal user sessions.
